Assays for bioanalysis of GuHong compounds and studyrelated compounds in biosamples
To facilitate the pharmacokinetic investigation of GuHong, four types of bioanalysis were performed: (1) profiling of Honghua compounds (unchanged and metabolized) in biosamples;(2) quantification of significantly in vivo-exposed compounds originating from Honghua in biosamples;(3) quantification of N-acetyl-L-glutamine, L-glutamine, N-acetyl-DL-glutamine-2,3,3,4,4-d and L-glutamine-2,3,3,4,4-d in biosamples;
